description: This file defines the RunFromPool class, which models the <run-from-pool> XML element within the Apache OFBiz framework's service configuration. It handles parsing the 'name' attribute and provides a getter for it. It is part of the configuration modeling for service pools.

classes.name: RunFromPool
classes.description: Models the <run-from-pool> XML configuration element, encapsulating its 'name' attribute and providing access to it.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name attribute of the <run-from-pool> element.
